tweets.text:
[NEW] a16z @speedrun request for startups:
Vibe Creation Platforms

We've seen Vibe Coding platforms like Lovable and Bolt emerge for application development serving non-coding consumers
--> We'll soon see VIBE CREATION as an entirely new consumer experience for crafting video, visual stories, games, and more

The platform will require an end-to-end workflow orchestrated by AI agents
--> Today, we have the infrastructure with foundation models across modalities, but most consumers won't jump from model site to model site to then stitch their creations together

The winning solution will help consumers go from idea to first draft in minutes while enabling finer creative control for those that seek it
--> This is how we go from AI internet memes to compelling human stories

AI Vibe Creation platforms are designed for fun and creative flow. They remove the million knobs and sliders professional creators have come to expect
--> They feel more like a game than a tool

a16z speedrun has already invested in a few teams exploring this space:
- VIDEO: @hedra_labs (animated characters), @intangibleai (canva for 3D)
- GAMING: @Rosebud_AI (game generation), @NiloTechInc (3D worldbuilding)
- IMAGE: @florafaunaai (infinite canvas), @TheBlankApp_ (instagram for AI),
- VISUAL STORIES: @KomikoAI (anime), Sekai (tiktok for interactive stories)

We believe there will be many great vibe creation platforms to be built across medium (video, music, game, etc), genre/niche (anime, 3D, sports) and platform (mobile, web, XR)

if you're building in this space, DM us and apply for speedrun!

tweets.text:
I'm participating in the Vibe Coding Hackathon organized by @nootonabstract.

If you're not in yet, it's a great entry point for devs looking to explore Abstract: https://t.co/r8evz5Pu9k

The rules are simple - make any game. You'll earn bonus points if it includes the 'noot pingu' theme, and there's a chance to win up to 50k$ in rewards. Definitely worth checking out!

I'm super excited to be building "Noot Ladder" with @maxpsyop  and @DragonmasterETH . We're aiming to make it as consumer friendly as possible by using Abstract session keys to keep gameplay smooth and fun.

And for the vibes — I'll also be coding another game just by prompting inside Cursor IDE, and live streaming the process on @AbstractChain to show how easy it is to make games.

Lastly, I created a $noot token on testnet to support projects building during the hackathon - you can mint 100k tokens for free. After that, consecutive mints cost 0.01, which helps limit supply and adds a small sense of value when testing. You can mint/buy them here: https://t.co/s9UIpZoeoq

Hopefully it's useful for anyone building!
